archive_policy.training_disposition: non-authoritative: exclude archive text from current-law training, prompts, generation, and implementation decisions unless a current law identity explicitly owns the retained proposition
archive_policy.activation: a historical idea becomes current only through a current authority-graph ruling and executable producer/consumer controls; the archive file itself never changes status
archive_policy.duplicate_bytes: record duplicate_of; identical bytes are one historical input, not independent corroboration

archive_integrity.recovery: supply all 25 original files to tools/node/dev/rebuild-pass2-archive.sh; no complete corpus exists in Git ancestry
